gem_guidance.text: Gemming as a Retribution Paladin In regards to gemming correctly, there are going to be some cases where we use appropriate color sockets, with the primary focus to fulfill the 2 Yellow and 2 Blue requirement for our best Meta gem: Relentless Earthstorm Diamond . However, we will otherwise generally gem pure Red +Strength gems like Bold Living Ruby , unless we get more total Strength by taking the socket bonus. There is very little nuance to the gemming strategy.

title: Retribution Paladin DPS Phase 1 Best in Slot (BiS) - TBC Classic - Wowhead
